fields.title: Expert call — AI search market structure
fields.key-claims: Claims logged as claims: distribution partnerships, not model quality, decide who keeps query share; answer engines' click-out economics favour incumbents with publisher deals; enterprise seats are expanding faster than consumer subscriptions. None of this is verified by the call itself.
fields.follow-ups: Test the distribution claim against the customer-concentration summary received 2026-11-01; ask for a second expert with a publisher-side view.

fields.title: Customer reference — enterprise research buyer
fields.interviewee: IT lead at a mid-size financial-services firm (customer reference)
fields.key-claims: Says the team uses the product daily for research workflows and expanded seats twice in a year; says answer citations are the reason they renewed. Seat counts and spend were described, not documented.
fields.follow-ups: Ask the company for the account's contract and usage records under the cohort-retention request; one reference is a claim, a pattern across references is evidence.
